title: Answer: the elements are a binary register of a vacuum finite-state machine

statements.text: IT3-WavePixel models the vacuum as a 16-bit finite-state machine with three registers: the nuclear charge $Z$ as a hardware address, the neutron number as error-correcting padding, and a 172-bit electron occupation mask. Decays, electron capture and the Auger effect become exact register transitions.

sources.quote: transitioning the physical vacuum into a 16-bit computational finite-state machine (FSM)
The Periodic Table is a binary register.
